name: escapes_comments_and_errors
description: Comments and blank lines are skipped; `\ ` escapes a space and `\#` a leading hash; a `#` token ends the owners; a negation or `***` is reported and skipped; `/` alone owns nothing.

input.file:
# comment
  
!secret @a
a/***/b @b
my\ file.txt @space   # owners end here
\#notes @hash
ok.txt @x #not-an-owner @y
/ @root
